description: A requested attribute named dynamic takes the dynamic property
notes: In the JSON syntax, a property named dynamic can define either an attribute or dynamic blocks, and the README doesn't say which one a schema that requests an attribute named dynamic gets (see native/dynamic-blocks/attribute-named-dynamic for the native syntax, where they can't be confused). hashicorp/hcl adds the block type dynamic to the schema (expandBody.extendSchema in ext/dynblock/expand_body.go), and the JSON syntax matches a property to an attribute before a block type (body.PartialContent in json/structure.go; see json/bodies/schema-attribute-and-block-type-same-name), so the dynamic property is the attribute.
